visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an indoor martial arts dojo with dark wooden floors and white walls. Several people in black keikogi are present; one man is kneeling while another person in sunglasses and a blue sash stands beside him. (2) A woman is shown being handed a katana with purple hilt wrapping; she examines the blade while a man in the background watches. (3) The group performs synchronized sword swings in the studio, with the camera switching between close-ups of the woman and medium shots of the group. (4) A man in black gear strikes a wooden training dummy with a katana; then the person in sunglasses strikes the dummy, which is knocked over. (5) A man prepares to slice a milk carton placed on a stand; he performs a rapid draw-and-cut motion. (6) The milk carton is sliced, but the woman filming with her phone is startled and falls backward onto the floor, laughing uncontrollably. (7) A close-up reveals a small toy sword is stuck to the front of the woman's black garment as if she has been impaled, continuing her laughter while kneeling on the floor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy music begins immediately, featuring a male vocalist singing a Mandarin version of 'I'll Make a Man Out of You' over a driving synthesized beat. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect plays in sync with a sword motion. (3) A heavy 'thud' sound occurs as a wooden dummy is struck and falls. (4) A crisp 'slice' sound effect coincides with the man cutting a milk carton. (5) High-pitched, exuberant female laughter erupts suddenly as the camera shakes. (6) A male voice enters the mix near the end, asking 'Are you okay?' in a calm, inquiring tone while the woman continues to laugh.
